consequence.statement: New feature added; the evidence states no operational consequence for operators.

original.statement: Loki 3.0.0 adds native OTLP ingestion support.

decision.reason: [ev-4c42b6db5d61] lists native OTLP ingestion support only as an added feature under 3.0.0 › Features. It gives no sign that anything existing fails, is rejected, stops being honoured or must be migrated, and no sign that a default changes. A consequence of "none" (informational) fits this purely additive entry. Confidence is low because the excerpt is one line and doesn't say whether the feature is on by default.
